" @FAO 's support was a big help to us, especially since around 1,000 farmers received assistance. The cash for livelihood was one of the ways for us to recover and restart farming. The same goes for the cash-for-work program, where the beneficiaries got paid for their work."

- Mark Francis Ibo, OIC, Municipal Agriculturist of Minalabac, Camarines Sur

When Typhoon Kristine (STS Trami) caused widespread flooding and landslide in Camarines Sur, Municipal Agriculturist Mark Francis Ibo described the impact to farming communities as a wake-up call for everyone. As part of the local government, he emphasized the importance of ensuring that small-scale farmers are well-informed about the support available to them from both the government and humanitarian organizations.

#EmergenciesCantWait #NationalDisasterResilience #KUMIKILOS #AgricultureCan #FAO80
